characterization_methods: Inductively coupled plasma reactive ion etching (ICPRIE)
evidence: The microstructures of the films were analyzed by x-ray diffraction (XRD) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM). The chemical composition and the impurity level were analyzed by x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The root-mean-square (RMS) roughness of the film was measured by atomic force microscopy (AFM). The Ru nanostructures were observed by a field emission scanning electron microscope (FE-SEM) and a high resolution transmission electron microscope (HRTEM). The electrical property (current–voltage) of the Ru nanowire array device was measured by using a Keithley 4200 semiconductor analyzer with a HP4284A LCR meter. The cross-sectional TEM images of the interfaces between AAO templates and Si substrates were shown. The FE-SEM images of the fabricated Ru nanostructures on Si substrates were shown. The HR-TEM images showing the Ru nanowires were shown. The FE-SEM images of the Ru nanowire array device were shown. The I–V characteristics of the Ru nanowire array device were shown.
